lines.zh: 我在空中悬一下，再往前。
lines.en: I hover, then drift forward.

lines.zh: 我在你头发上方打着圈子。
lines.en: I circle above your hair.
My wings make a thin whine.
I skim over the tips of the grass.
I fly where there's warmth.
I drift along behind you.
I settle on a leaf and lift off.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，回到你身边。
lines.en: I circle and come back to you.
I fly slowly enough that you can't catch me.
I follow the smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 我从你后颈那边飞过去。
lines.en: I pass by the back of your neck.
I hang in the air, looking for somewhere to land.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里飞，凉一点。
lines.en: I fly in your shadow; it's cooler.
I drift around behind you.
I come in, dipping and rising.

lines.zh: 我在你的手臂边上打转。
lines.en: I turn in circles by your arm.
I rest beneath the leaf, wings folded.
My wings still quiver.
I'm waiting for something warm.
The grass around stirs slightly.
I take a sip of nectar.

lines.zh: 我的口器收着，还没伸出来。
lines.en: My mouthparts are folded away.
I hear the sound of blood.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶背，一动也不动。
lines.en: I cling to the leaf's underside, perfectly still.
I'm in a crack in the bark.
A leaf is hiding me from above.
I straighten my legs.
I haven't tasted blood in a long while.
I rest in the hollow of a vein.
There are footsteps coming near.
Your neck is right there.
I pass by your ear.
You swat and miss me.

lines.zh: 我停在你袖口的褶皱里。
lines.en: I settle into the folds of your cuff.
You haven't noticed me.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的手腕往上走。
lines.en: I walk up along your wrist.

lines.zh: 你的血管在皮肤底下鼓动。
lines.en: Your veins pulse under the skin.
Will you swat a second time?
I circle once and come back.

lines.zh: 我的口器慢慢伸了出来。
lines.en: My mouthparts slowly extend.
I tumble and my wings tangle.
I drop a stretch and steady.
One wing is crumpled.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，慢慢爬起来。
lines.en: I land on the ground and climb up slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕了很大一圈才飞回来。
lines.en: It takes a wide circle to come back.
My mouthparts have retracted.
I shake and lose a few hairs.
I fly under a leaf to hide.
I wait a while before moving.

lines.zh: 歇一会，我还能再扑一次。
lines.en: Give me a moment; I can dive again.
I catch that sweetness.
I settle in the flower's heart.
Two sips and I've had enough.
This is sweeter than what I usually get.
Pollen clings to me now.

lines.zh: 我围着那点甜味打了个转。
lines.en: I loop once around that hint of sweetness.

lines.zh: 这东西吃不了，只是闻着像。
lines.en: It's not food, only smells like it.
I beat my wings and fly off.

lines.zh: 会动的东西比花更合我意。
lines.en: Something that moves suits me better than flowers.
Sweet things don't fill me.
You swat and the wind throws me off.
I'm blown a short distance.
I steady my wings and come back.

lines.zh: 你的手扫过，我差点栽下去。
lines.en: Your hand sweeps past and I nearly drop.

lines.zh: 我在你的掌风里翻了个身。
lines.en: I tumble in the draft of your hand.
I land on the sleeve and grip the cloth.

lines.zh: 我的翅被撞得折了半边。
lines.en: The bump folds one of my wings.
I'm rising again.

lines.zh: 我绕到你手够不到的地方。
lines.en: I get beyond where your hand can reach.

lines.zh: 我悬在你手边，等你松懈。
lines.en: I hover by your hand, waiting for it to drop.
A swarm hovers in one place.
The two of us stay very close.
We circle over the water.

lines.zh: 她的翅声和我的不一样。
lines.en: Her wing-whine differs from mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起落在一根枝上。
lines.en: We settle on one twig together.

lines.zh: 她没有血可以喝，我也一样。
lines.en: She has no blood to drink, and neither do I.
We fly a stretch side by side.
She heads for the water.
There will be more of us there.
In the end we part.
I sip a little from the flower.
Not enough; I move to another.
I can't fly while drinking.
My mouthparts are too short to reach.
I'm covered in pollen.
Done, I shake my legs.
I land on that drop of water.
This doesn't taste like a flower.

lines.zh: 我吸了两下就飞起来了。
lines.en: Two draws and I lift off.
I circle back and land where I was.
Something warm is over there.
I fly that way.
The smell is strong — blood.
I circle once to check the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往你那边靠近。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward you.
I settle on your collar.
That's close enough now.

lines.zh: 我在找一个好下口的地方。
lines.en: I'm looking for a good place to bite.

lines.zh: 我落在你背后，你毫无察觉。
lines.en: I land behind you and you never notice.
I crawl forward a little.
You haven't even raised your head.
I'm about to come down.
I'm pressed against your skin.
I work my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 你的巴掌抬起来了，我先躲。
lines.en: Your hand is rising; I dodge first.

lines.zh: 我转到你视线够不到的一侧。
lines.en: I slip to the side your eyes can't reach.
I settle on your shoulder again.
I keep changing places.
You can't swat me at all.
I land on the back of your neck.
I push my mouthparts in a little.
Your skin tightens.
I begin to draw your blood.
You wave and I lift off.
I settle back where I was.
I drive my mouthparts in.
It leaves only a tiny opening.
One draw and I lift off.
You swat; I dodge.
I settle back and draw again.
A red spot rises on your skin.
I drink too fast and stall.
You've caught my wing.
I pull free, losing a few hairs.

lines.zh: 我飞远了，绕一圈再回来。
lines.en: I fly off and circle back.
I fly heavy with a swollen belly.

lines.zh: 我又在你胳膊上落了一处。
lines.en: I settle again on your arm.

lines.zh: 我从水面上的幼虫壳里出来。
lines.en: I come up out of the water as a new adult.

lines.zh: 新翅还软，我先停在枝上。
lines.en: My new wings are soft; I rest on a twig.
I wait on a grass stem.
My wings spread slowly.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见血的声音。
lines.en: For the first time I hear blood.
The sun has moved; time to go.
I fly a short distance.
My wings are hard enough now.
I follow the smell of warmth.
There are living things here.
I hover in the grass.
I've noted the smell of this place.
I circle once and don't leave.
I'll wait for the light to dim a little.

lines.zh: 热气一扑，我的翅尖焦了。
lines.en: A wave of heat and my wingtips curl.
I fall into the grass and can't right myself.
Water pins me down.

lines.zh: 那股冲力把我吹得翻跟头。
lines.en: The blast hurls me far away.

lines.zh: 有什么细东西刺穿了我的翅。
lines.en: Something slender pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅膀不动了。
lines.en: The light stops my wings.

lines.zh: 找不到热的东西，我发虚。
lines.en: No warmth to find, and I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我贴着草不敢动。
lines.en: The flash pins me to the grass.
Below is an endless emptiness; I drift.
